unit.unitinstructions:
🌐 Wiki World Maps

Practice 200 country locator maps sourced from Wikimedia Commons regional locator-map files.

  • What you will do: Each card shows a locator map and you type the country name from memory.
  • Image source: Maps are loaded directly from Wikimedia Commons SVG URLs rather than bundled local files.
  • Attribution: Each map includes a small linked caption with creator, source, and license information.
  • How it works: Feedback appears immediately after each response so you can connect the visual cue to the correct country name.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling returns uncertain countries sooner and spaces familiar ones farther apart.

Use the highlighted region, surrounding geography, and overall placement as clues, then begin when you are ready.
